errors.text_span: mapped to "Context Retrieving" are "Memorization" (light aquamarine, 100), "Dynamic Instruction" (turquoise, 100), and "Multitasking" (teal, 160)
errors.evidence: The description lists the sub-capabilities for "Context Retrieving" in the order: Memorization, Dynamic Instruction, Multitasking. However, the clockwise order of the corresponding slices on the chart is Multitasking, Dynamic Instruction, Memorization. This reverses the actual spatial arrangement of the slices.

The description incorrectly maps the labels "Memorization" and "Dynamic Instruction" to their respective slices. The line from the label "Memorization 100" points to the rightmost slice of the group (light aquamarine), and the line from "Dynamic Instruction 100" points to the middle slice (turquoise). The description reverses this mapping.
